messages:
Alex: Quick idea — LAN + potluck tomorrow evening? BYOR (bring your own rig) but totally fine to just show up for couch games. Mezzanine 18:30. Who's in? :pizza:

Nina: Love it. I can bring my gaming laptop and a small external monitor, plus a bag of chips. Anyone need a display?

Carlos: I'm down. Bringing a PC, a Steam backlog, and my Vive Pro if people wanna try some local VR demos. Might need an extension cable.

Becky: Count me in for socials. I only have a Switch and controllers. I can also bring a giant bowl of potato salad (allergy note: has eggs).

Alex: Nice. Quick logistics: we'll have limited outlets on the mezzanine so power strips + surge recommended. Also tag what you're bringing so we don't double up.

Nina: Bringing HDMI cable + USB-C power brick. Also a power strip.

Carlos: I'll pack extra DisplayPort-to-HDMI adapters and an ethernet cable. If anyone wants to try Beat Saber on the Vive, bring comfy socks. :socks:

Becky: I can loan two Switch controllers. Also happy to coordinate snacks (vegan cookies too).

Alex: Mini RSVP grid: PC rigs, VR, Switch/controllers, snacks/potluck, power strips
Alex: Alex: PC rig + power strip
Nina: Laptop + monitor + power strip
Carlos: PC + Vive (VR) + adapters + ethernet
Becky: Switch + 2 controllers + potato salad

OpsBot: Calendar: Mezzanine reserved 18:30-22:30 tomorrow by Alex. Reminder scheduled 3 hours before.

Nina: Also suggestion — let's set up a tiny LAN-only Discord voice channel for both comms and music. Keeps phone hotspots out of the way.

Carlos: Agree. I'll bring a travel router to host a small subnet. Pro tip: set the router to channel 6 for least interference in the mezzanine.

Becky: Anyone want to split cleanup/packdown duty? I can stay 30 mins after to help bag up leftovers.

Alex: Can we do a quick rota? Becky + Nina for cleanup, Carlos helps with unplugging rigs. I'll handle moving tables.

Nina: Perfect. See y'all at 18:30. If plans change ping here. :v:
